text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The public is astonished by the runaway style Silence Suzuka employs during her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove cautions her of the difficulties that lie ahead, and warns me not to waste Silence Suzuka's talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take the warning to heart, firmly determined to become a pillar of support for Silence Suzuka.
